evidence.raw_content:
NH-XX Highway Development Daily Site Log
Date: 04 Sep 2026
Shift: Morning & Afternoon
Contractor: L&T Civil Infrastructure Joint Venture
Location: Zone A (Corridor North)
Chainage: 10+200 to 10+800
Activity: Earthwork Excavation in roadway cut and embankment foundation.
Equipment Deployed: 4x CAT 320D Excavators, 12x 16-Tonne Tippers, 1x CAT 120M Motor Grader, 1x Hamm 311 Compactor.
Executed Quantity: 1,200 cubic metres (m3) excavated, hauled to designated borrow disposal area.
Weather: Clear, 28°C, soil moisture optimal.
Certified by: Site Resident Engineer - Rajesh Sharma

Weekly Structural Progress Inspection
Location: Chainage 12+500 (Culvert Crossing)
Planned Culverts: 10 Nos Box Culverts (3x3m)
Status: Only 4 completed to date. Culvert 5 & 6 delayed due to high water table and dewatering pump requisition delays.
Variance: -10% critical schedule slippage.
Inspected by: Senior Structural Consultant Dr. V. Menon

Aerial Photogrammetry & LiDAR Survey Report
Flight Corridor: KM 08+500 to 10+000 Zone A
Activity: Granular Sub-base (GSB) Layer 1 compaction
Certified Quantity: 3,250 m³ verified through DTM surface difference analysis.
Compaction density: 98.4% MDD confirmed by nuclear density gauge cross-check.

Compressive Strength Test Certificate - M30 Grade Concrete
Location: Chainage 14+000 to 16+000 (Concrete Drain Construction)
28-Day Target: 30.0 N/mm²
Mean 28-Day Strength Achieved: 34.2 N/mm² (Accepted)
Cumulative Length Cast: 1,000 m certified.

Hot Mix Asphalt Batch Plant Ticket & Sensor Paver Log
Location: Zone C KM 20+000 to 22+500
Activity: Asphalt Base Course (Dense Bituminous Macadam)
Bitumen Grade: VG-40 modified
Quantity Delivered & Paved: 2,560 m² (32% completed)
Temperature at Laydown: 155°C (Within specification 140°C - 165°C)

alerts.message: A104 Culvert Construction (Chainage 12+500) has -10% variance. Only 4 of 10 planned culverts completed due to dewatering delays.
A101 Earthwork Excavation is at 80% actual progress vs 85% planned target (-5% variance).
A102 Granular Sub-base Zone A running 5% behind planned target. Quarry crushed aggregate delivery slower than cycle demand.
Zone C Bituminous Paving: Intermittent monsoon precipitation forecasted. Pre-monsoon prime coat curing monitored.
A103 Concrete Drain Construction: 28-day cube strength tests passed at 34.2 MPa, exceeding 30 MPa requirement.
